fields.description: Creek Bay offers one to three bedroom apartments beside the waterfront in Dubai Creek Harbour. The development includes two towers and a separate group of low-rise podium homes. Its published plans show substantial differences in terrace space, including layouts that are much larger than the headline apartment sizes used in launch advertising.

reviewCoverage.identity: Existing Creek Bay owner/ID matched to Emaar. Third-party document index reviewed only for named public Emaar-branded packs, not its price/service-charge assertions.
reviewCoverage.location: Dubai Creek Harbour waterfront and community landmarks verified in brochure; planned Blue Line not described as operating.
reviewCoverage.residences: One to three bedroom apartments. A/B towers and Podium Units C independently identified in plan packs; C not mislabelled as a third high-rise tower.
reviewCoverage.areas: 19-page developer-hosted Tower B, 18-page broker-hosted Tower A and six-page Podium C plans reviewed. Table uses printed total areas, not older rounded fact-sheet minima.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Brochure page 9 provides pools, garden, play, fitness, padel, multipurpose, yoga and walking facilities; official page adds BBQ/picnic.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Captured official project page units-from AED 3,252,888 used; earlier AED 1.8 million headline and other stale availability feeds distinguished.
reviewCoverage.payment: Tower A/B Emaar-branded copied fact sheets visually reviewed: 10/70/20 with distinct early dates. Bayut agrees. Property Finder FAQ reverses percentages to 70/20/10; not adopted.
reviewCoverage.handover: Both copied sheets April 2030, corroborated by Property Finder and Bayut Q2 2030. Remains a reported target pending current developer contract.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official 25-page brochure and Tower B pack, separately attributed A/C packs and both fact sheets read. All captured document URLs preserved; no site images changed.

overview: Creek Bay’s brochure describes a promenade setting with pools, gardens and places to exercise or meet neighbours. The apartment interiors use a light palette and open living spaces. The outdoor setting is a major part of the proposal, but a creek or Burj Khalifa view depends on the specific floor, orientation and surrounding development.
research.locationNote: The brochure map places Creek Bay within Dubai Creek Harbour, with the marina, harbour promenade, Central Park, Creek Beach and the Viewing Point in the surrounding community. Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is nearby. The advertised Blue Line connection is future infrastructure; quoted driving times are estimates rather than promises.
research.priceNote: The reviewed Emaar project page displays units from AED 3,252,888, alongside an earlier AED 1.8 million headline. The displayed unit figure is the reference used here. Availability feeds and launch prices can differ; a dated unit quotation is still required.
research.paymentNote: The copied Tower A and B launch fact sheets show 10% on booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at completion. Early dates differ by tower, as shown below. Bayut corroborates the split. Property Finder’s FAQ reverses the percentages, so its payment sequence is not used. Past launch dates do not establish terms for a new booking.
research.handoverNote: Both copied launch sheets identify April 2030 as the estimated completion point. Bayut reports Q2 2030 and Property Finder reports April 2030. These references agree, but current developer terms and construction progress still need confirmation.

facts.label: Tower configurations
facts.value: The reviewed key sections number Tower A’s residential levels to 44 and Tower B’s to 38, above basement, ground and three podium levels.

facts.label: Podium homes
facts.value: The separate C booklet identifies ground and podium apartments between the towers. Its three bedroom layouts include a maid’s room and a terrace.

facts.label: Reading the plans
facts.value: Total areas include balconies or terraces. Compare indoor suite areas separately, particularly where a large terrace accounts for much of the size difference.
